observation.command: find /workspace -name "config.toml" -path "*cargo*" 2>/dev/null; find /workspace -name ".cargo" -type d 2>/dev/null; echo "=== env ==="; env | grep -i "cargo\|rustc\|linker\|cc" | head; echo "=== rustup config ==="; cat ~/.cargo/config.toml 2>/dev/null; cat ~/.cargo/config 2>/dev/null; echo "=== any linker refs in flake ==="; grep -rn "clang\|linker" /workspace/flake.nix 2>/dev/null | head
